Hi Diego / Monica,

We received the supplier portal invite email and when our vendor opens the link from our Android app (their in-app WebView) the page loads but the "Accept" button and the form fields are missing — it's basically a blank content area with the header. Workarounds tried: tapping "Open in browser" fixes it (Chrome shows the full page), but our mobile onboarding workflow requires the vendor to accept inside our app (so we need the in-app flow to work). Any idea what's blocking rendering in WebView?

App/device: Vendor reported Android 11, WebView 94. Vendor company: Clipper Co.

Can you advise or resend a different link?

Subject: Re: Supplier invite not rendering correctly on Android app (triage notes)

I've reproduced the issue on Android WebView 94 (emulator) loading the invite link. Short summary of findings:

1) The invite page relies on a small inline script that enhances the accept CTA; when the WebView blocks "unsafe-inline" due to a stricter CSP from a proxy (some WebViews enforce stricter defaults), the button element is created but styling or JS-driven placement doesn't occur, leaving the visible area blank.
2) There's also a SameSite cookie on our redirect chain that WebView treats differently (it doesn't set the cookie for cross-site navigations in some versions), which can trigger an alternate lightweight landing that doesn't render the full form.

Temporary workaround (what we can do right away):
- Resend invite with the query parameter &force_simple=1 which serves a minimal, non-JS page with a plain anchor that triggers the acceptance flow server-side (no inline script needed).
- Alternatively, resend a full URL and include an explicit header fallback to force desktop rendering (we have a flag in the onboarding service to skip the JS enhancement).

Longer-term fixes (tracked in ONB-742):
- Remove inline JS dependency for critical CTA in the invite flow, add progressive enhancement.
- Adjust SameSite cookie path/attributes for broader WebView compatibility.

I've created repro steps and added them to the Drive link: https://drive.google.com/open?id=1aB2cExampleLink and filed ONB-742.

Action for Ari / Clipper Co.: can you confirm if you want us to resend the invite with &force_simple=1 now? If so we'll resend and monitor acceptance.

Attachments: repro-steps.txt
